cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only six people cracked your supper-club invitation. Excellent. All those evenings I spent teaching you to choose an audience are paying off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Five thought it was a puzzle night. They've cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Your wording filtered out people who weren't serious about dinner. You used to invite absolutely everyone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The last one's the printer asking to be paid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A private dinner with our supplier. That's a much more useful audience. Set two places; you're finally learning to keep a guest list tight.

reason: Give the familiar training relationship a concrete role in the exact pursuit. Keep D137 planned-design claims distinct from D140 improvement claims, and make truth bait or procedure borrowing depend on actual B replies.
